timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,530–1,550 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently very weak, with the exchange rate hovering at multi-year highs around 1,530–1,550 KRW per USD—meaning you need significantly more won to buy $2,000. While news suggests the second half of 2026 may see rates fall (driven by semiconductor dollar inflows and potential won stabilization), current levels are near post-financial-crisis peaks, making this an unfavorable entry point for your monthly conversion.

TIP: Consider staggering your conversions across multiple days in coming weeks if the won strengthens, or set a target rate (e.g., 1,450–1,480) rather than converting the full amount at today's weak levels.
